rules.check: maps, slices and queues that grow with use also shrink, or are bounded
rules.evidence: the line that adds to the collection with no removal or cap

rules.check: a request or call does not read or write a whole file or table when it needs a part
rules.evidence: the line that loads the whole file or table inside the per-request or per-call path

rules.check: expensive work is not repeated inside a loop when it can be done once outside it
rules.evidence: the line inside the loop that parses, queries, reads or scans again on each pass

rules.check: work driven by a request has limits on size, time and concurrency
rules.evidence: the line that reads, waits or fans out with no size, timeout or concurrency cap
